Mindful focus and remembrance of Allah

PureVision is an offline, privacy-first Islamic mindfulness and reminder companion. It helps you keep your gaze pure and your heart connected to Allah throughout daily phone usage by displaying gentle, customizable zikr and reminders on your screen.

Quick answers to help you get the best experience
What is PureVision and what is its main purpose?

PureVision is a 100% offline, privacy-first Islamic reminder and mindfulness app. Its purpose is to help you guard your gaze and keep your heart connected with the remembrance of Allah (dhikr) throughout daily phone usage by displaying gentle, non-intrusive reminders around your screen notch or status bar.
Does running the service 24/7 in the background drain battery?
Not at all! PureVision is lightweight and highly optimized. It runs completely offline without network polls, heavy animations, or background wake-locks. Battery impact is practically negligible.
Will PureVision stop if I clear Recent Apps or restart my phone?

No. PureVision continues running even when cleared from recent apps, and automatically starts when your device boots up. For uninterrupted 24/7 operation, make sure to set Battery Optimization for PureVision to \'Unrestricted\' in your device settings.
Can I hide the \'PureVision Service is active\' notification?

Yes, completely!
Android requires foreground services to display a status notification. However, you can easily hide it:
1. Open Settings > 'Hide / Manage Notification'.
2. Turn off the 'Service Background Status' notification category.
The on-screen overlay will continue running smoothly without showing the notification!
My phone has a center notch; can I position the reminder below or beside it?

Yes! PureVision is tailored for modern phone cutouts:\n• Enable \'Center Notch Island\' mode to wrap the reminder in an elegant pill box right below your camera cutout.\n• Use the horizontal (X) and vertical (Y) sliders to adjust the exact position anywhere on your screen.
Why is live Zikr not appearing on my lock screen?

To view live Zikr on your lock screen, ensure lock screen notifications are enabled in your phone settings. Turn on \'Live Zikr on Notification & Lock Screen\' on the main screen and allow lock screen notification content in your system settings.
What should I do if Android shows \"Restricted setting\"?

On Android 13+, sideloaded APKs require extra confirmation for accessibility and overlay permissions. To fix this:
1. Go to phone Settings > Apps > PureVision (App Info).
2. Tap the top-right 3-dot (⋮) menu.
3. Tap 'Allow restricted settings' and confirm with your device PIN or fingerprint.
4. Return to PureVision and enable the overlay permission.
Is my data safe? Does PureVision access the internet?
PureVision is 100% offline and privacy-first. The app does not request internet permission and collects zero user data. Your privacy is completely guaranteed.
Can I add custom Arabic/Bengali dhikr or Quranic verses?
Yes! In the \'Custom Text\' section, you can write any Quranic ayah, dua, or personal reflection. You can also customize the Zikr list with your preferred dhikr phrases.
How can I back up my settings when changing phones?
In the Settings page, tap \'Backup Settings\' to save your customized configuration to a file. On your new phone, tap \'Restore Settings\' to restore all your preferences in one tap.
